author: Ghost Developer Studio
description: A short quality loop for any finished piece of work on {{target}}: audit what was built, improve it twice with separate changes, then verify the result with evidence.

inputs.description: The file, tool, or change to audit.
inputs.name: target

name: Audit, Improve, Verify
notes: A claim without evidence does not count as verified. Report failures plainly.

steps.detail: Read {{target}} against its stated goal. List what is missing, weak, or unproven, in priority order. Do not fix anything yet.
steps.title: Audit the work

steps.detail: Fix the top finding only. Re-run any tests or checks.
steps.title: First improvement

steps.detail: Fix the next finding, or strengthen the weakest part if no findings remain. This must be a different change from the first improvement.
steps.gate: Two improvements means two separate changes.
steps.title: Second improvement

steps.detail: Show the final test run, output, or file state that proves the work holds. State plainly anything that could not be verified.
steps.title: Verify with evidence

steps.detail: Report what was built, what the audit found, what changed in each improvement, and what verification showed.
steps.title: Report plainly
